data.description: Landing page with overview of features and entry points: get inspired with a recipe, meal planning, ingredient inventory, saved recipes, onboarding for first time users

questions: What is your cooking mastery level?
What kitchen equipment do you have?
How much time do you prefer to spend cooking?
Do you have preferred cuisines/flavor profiles?

data.description: Core feature. User enters available ingredients and gets recipe suggestions, can ask for random inspiration or search by filters. Includes ability to browse trending/TikTok recipes.
Page for adding and updating ingredients available at home; includes automatic deduction of used items after cooking, and manual adjustment. View who added what in shared households.
Weekly calendar to plan meals. Drag and drop recipes to days. Shows shopping checklist for missing ingredients.
Auto-generated shopping list from planned recipes and current inventory. User can check off items; includes push notification/reminder for unmet ingredients before meal dates.
User can save favorite recipes for later, organize by categories, add notes, and mark as 'made' or rate for future recommendations.
Step-by-step guides with illustrations, cooking tips, timers, and equipment adaptations if needed. Includes sharing options and ability to rate/like recipes.
Manage preferences: cooking level, kitchen inventory, dietary restrictions, notification settings, and social sharing settings.
Sends a notification to remind users to buy missing ingredients ahead of planned meals.
Share recipes or planning success via social media or with other app users/household members.

edges.when: First time user or settings reset
